Generate TikZ Code from a Causal Graph

Source: R/make-tikz.R
make_tikz.Rd

Generates LaTeX TikZ code from a Disco, Knowledge, or caugi::caugi object, preserving node positions, labels, and visual styles. Edges are rendered with arrows, line widths, and colors. The output is readable LaTeX code that can be directly compiled or modified.

Usage

make_tikz(
  x,
  ...,
  style = c("default", "classic"),
  scale = 10,
  full_doc = TRUE,
  bend = NULL,
  tier_label_pos = c("above", "below", "left", "right"),
  node_labels = NULL,
  tier_labels = NULL,
  bend_edges = lifecycle::deprecated(),
  bend_angle = lifecycle::deprecated()
)

Arguments

x

A Disco, Knowledge, or caugi::caugi object.

...

Additional arguments passed to plot() and caugi::plot().

style

"default" mirrors plot(). "classic" is a minimal look with plain-text nodes, gray tier bands, and a time axis. See Details.

scale

Numeric scalar. Scaling factor for node coordinates. Default is 10.

full_doc

Logical. If TRUE (default), generates a full standalone LaTeX document. If FALSE, returns only the tikzpicture environment; load \usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta, bending, backgrounds, fit, calc} in your preamble.

bend

How much edges are bent, in degrees:

  • A number bends every edge by that angle; 0 draws edges straight, and a negative number bends them the other way (see Details). Edges may still be bent differently to avoid nodes.

  • A named list sets the bend of individual edges, in the same nested form as edge_style$by_edge: list(A = list(B = 20, C = -10)) bends the edge from A to B 20 degrees to the left (bend left=20) and the edge from A to C 10 degrees to the right; 0 draws an edge straight. Left and right are as seen going from the first to the second node, whichever way the edge points. These edges are drawn exactly as given. Add default = <number> to set the bend of all other edges, e.g. list(default = 20, A = list(B = 0)).

Default is 0 (10 for style = "classic").

tier_label_pos

Character string specifying the position of tier labels relative to the tier rectangles. Must be one of "above", "below", "left", or "right". Default is "above". For style = "classic", see Details.

node_labels, tier_labels

Optional named character vectors of LaTeX labels for nodes or tiers, e.g. c(child_x1 = "$X_1$"). Unlabelled nodes and tiers use their name.

bend_edges

Use bend instead: bend_edges = FALSE is bend = 0, and bend_edges = TRUE is bend = bend_angle.

bend_angle

Use bend instead.

Value

A character string containing LaTeX TikZ code. Depending on full_doc, this is either:

  • a complete LaTeX document (full_doc = TRUE), or

  • only the tikzpicture environment (full_doc = FALSE).

Details

The function calls plot() to generate a caugi::caugi_plot object, then traverses the plot object's grob structure to extract nodes and edges. Supported features include:

  • Nodes

    • Fill color and draw color (supports both named colors and custom RGB values)

    • Font size

    • Coordinates are scaled by the scale parameter

  • Edges

    • Line color and width

    • Arrow scale

    • Optional bending to reduce overlapping arrows

The output starts with named styles (var for nodes, link for edges, tier and tier label for tiers) for easy restyling, and edges are connected to nodes by name rather than coordinates.

Bent edges

With a positive bend (or default), edges bend to the left when they point to the right and vice versa, so they bulge upwards; with style = "classic" they always bend to the right. A negative angle bends them the other way. Edges in both directions (A --> B and B --> A) are bent to opposite sides, by that angle, or if it is 0, by 25 degrees (10 for style = "classic").

Like plot(), edges that would pass through another node are bent around it. A bent edge that would pass through a node is bent the other way instead, or, if that also hits a node, by the angle closest to its bend that clears all nodes. Bent edges that leave a node in nearly the same direction are spread apart, by bending them the other way or more. Node sizes are estimated from the labels, so a bend may need a manual tweak.

To draw edges exactly as requested, turn both adjustments off with edge_style = list(route = FALSE), or for single edges with edge_style$by_edge. Edges given in a bend list are always drawn exactly as given.

Classic style

Adds a time axis style, and the spacing is set by the x and y options of the tikzpicture. Tier labels go on the time axis: "below" (default) or "above" for column tiers, "left" (default) or "right" for row tiers.

Examples

################# Convert Knowledge to Tikz ################

data(num_data)
kn <- knowledge(
  num_data,
  X1 %-->% X2,
  X2 %!-->% X3 + Y,
  Y %!-->% Z
)

# Full standalone document
tikz_kn <- make_tikz(kn, scale = 10, full_doc = TRUE)
cat(tikz_kn)
#> %%% Generated by causalDisco (version 1.3.0)
#> \documentclass[tikz,border=2mm]{standalone}
#> \usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta, bending, backgrounds, fit, calc}
#> 
#> \begin{document}
#> \tikzset{
#>   var/.style={draw, circle, fill=lightgray},
#>   link/.style={draw=red, arrows={[scale=3]}}
#> }
#> \begin{tikzpicture}
#> \node[var] (X1) at (1.667,0) {X1};
#> \node[var] (X2) at (1.667,3.333) {X2};
#> \node[var] (X3) at (3.333,6.667) {X3};
#> \node[var] (Y) at (0,6.667) {Y};
#> \node[var] (Z) at (0,10) {Z};
#> \path (X1) edge[link, draw=blue, -Latex] (X2)
#>       (X2) edge[link, -Latex] (X3)
#>       (X2) edge[link, -Latex] (Y)
#>       (Y) edge[link, -Latex] (Z);
#> \end{tikzpicture}
#> \end{document}

# Only the tikzpicture environment
tikz_kn_snippet <- make_tikz(kn, full_doc = FALSE)
cat(tikz_kn_snippet)
#> %%% Generated by causalDisco (version 1.3.0)
#> \tikzset{
#>   var/.style={draw, circle, fill=lightgray},
#>   link/.style={draw=red, arrows={[scale=3]}}
#> }
#> \begin{tikzpicture}
#> \node[var] (X1) at (1.667,0) {X1};
#> \node[var] (X2) at (1.667,3.333) {X2};
#> \node[var] (X3) at (3.333,6.667) {X3};
#> \node[var] (Y) at (0,6.667) {Y};
#> \node[var] (Z) at (0,10) {Z};
#> \path (X1) edge[link, draw=blue, -Latex] (X2)
#>       (X2) edge[link, -Latex] (X3)
#>       (X2) edge[link, -Latex] (Y)
#>       (Y) edge[link, -Latex] (Z);
#> \end{tikzpicture}

# With bent edges
tikz_bent <- make_tikz(
  kn,
  full_doc = FALSE,
  bend = 25
)
cat(tikz_bent)
#> %%% Generated by causalDisco (version 1.3.0)
#> \tikzset{
#>   var/.style={draw, circle, fill=lightgray},
#>   link/.style={draw=red, arrows={[scale=3]}}
#> }
#> \begin{tikzpicture}
#> \node[var] (X1) at (1.667,0) {X1};
#> \node[var] (X2) at (1.667,3.333) {X2};
#> \node[var] (X3) at (3.333,6.667) {X3};
#> \node[var] (Y) at (0,6.667) {Y};
#> \node[var] (Z) at (0,10) {Z};
#> \path (X1) edge[link, draw=blue, bend left=25, -Latex] (X2)
#>       (X2) edge[link, bend right=25, -Latex] (X3)
#>       (X2) edge[link, bend right=25, -Latex] (Y)
#>       (Y) edge[link, bend left=25, -Latex] (Z);
#> \end{tikzpicture}

# With a color not supported by default TikZ colors; will fall back to RGB
tikz_darkblue <- make_tikz(
  kn,
  node_style = list(fill = "darkblue"),
  full_doc = FALSE
)
cat(tikz_darkblue)
#> %%% Generated by causalDisco (version 1.3.0)
#> \tikzset{
#>   var/.style={draw, circle, fill={rgb:red,0.000;green,0.000;blue,0.545}},
#>   link/.style={draw=red, arrows={[scale=3]}}
#> }
#> \begin{tikzpicture}
#> \node[var] (X1) at (1.667,0) {X1};
#> \node[var] (X2) at (1.667,3.333) {X2};
#> \node[var] (X3) at (3.333,6.667) {X3};
#> \node[var] (Y) at (0,6.667) {Y};
#> \node[var] (Z) at (0,10) {Z};
#> \path (X1) edge[link, draw=blue, -Latex] (X2)
#>       (X2) edge[link, -Latex] (X3)
#>       (X2) edge[link, -Latex] (Y)
#>       (Y) edge[link, -Latex] (Z);
#> \end{tikzpicture}

# With tiered knowledge
data(tpc_example)
kn_tiered <- knowledge(
  tpc_example,
  tier(
    child ~ starts_with("child"),
    youth ~ starts_with("youth"),
    old ~ starts_with("old")
  )
)
tikz_tiered_kn <- make_tikz(
  kn_tiered,
  full_doc = FALSE
)
cat(tikz_tiered_kn)
#> %%% Generated by causalDisco (version 1.3.0)
#> \tikzset{
#>   var/.style={draw, circle, fill=lightgray},
#>   link/.style={},
#>   tier/.style={draw, rectangle, fill=blue!20, rounded corners, inner sep=0.5cm},
#>   tier label/.style={}
#> }
#> \begin{tikzpicture}
#> \node[var] (child_x1) at (0,0) {child\_x1};
#> \node[var] (child_x2) at (0,10) {child\_x2};
#> \node[var] (youth_x3) at (5,0) {youth\_x3};
#> \node[var] (youth_x4) at (5,10) {youth\_x4};
#> \node[var] (oldage_x5) at (10,0) {oldage\_x5};
#> \node[var] (oldage_x6) at (10,10) {oldage\_x6};
#> \begin{scope}[on background layer]
#> \node[tier, fit=(child_x1)(child_x2)] (child) {};
#> \node[tier, fit=(oldage_x5)(oldage_x6)] (old) {};
#> \node[tier, fit=(youth_x3)(youth_x4)] (youth) {};
#> \end{scope}
#> \node[tier label, anchor=south] at ($(child.north)+(0cm,0.2cm)$) {child};
#> \node[tier label, anchor=south] at ($(old.north)+(0cm,0.2cm)$) {old};
#> \node[tier label, anchor=south] at ($(youth.north)+(0cm,0.2cm)$) {youth};
#> \path ;
#> \end{tikzpicture}

# Classic style with LaTeX labels
tikz_classic <- make_tikz(
  kn_tiered,
  style = "classic",
  node_labels = c(child_x1 = "$X_1$", child_x2 = "$X_2$"),
  tier_labels = c(child = "Childhood", old = "Old age"),
  full_doc = FALSE
)
cat(tikz_classic)
#> %%% Generated by causalDisco (version 1.3.0)
#> \tikzset{
#>   >={Stealth[length=2.2mm, width=1.7mm]},
#>   o/.tip={Circle[open, length=1.6mm]},
#>   var/.style={inner sep=2pt},
#>   link/.style={semithick},
#>   tier/.style={fill=black!8, inner sep=4pt},
#>   tier label/.style={font=\small},
#>   time axis/.style={semithick, -{Stealth[length=2mm]}}
#> }
#> \begin{tikzpicture}[x=3.5cm, y=1.5cm]
#> \node[var] (child_x1) at (-0.15,0) {$X_1$};
#> \node[var] (child_x2) at (0.15,1) {$X_2$};
#> \node[var] (youth_x3) at (0.85,0) {youth\_x3};
#> \node[var] (youth_x4) at (1.15,1) {youth\_x4};
#> \node[var] (oldage_x5) at (1.85,0) {oldage\_x5};
#> \node[var] (oldage_x6) at (2.15,1) {oldage\_x6};
#> \begin{scope}[on background layer]
#> \node[tier, fit={(child_x1)(child_x2)(0,-0.5)(0,1.5)}] (tier-1) {};
#> \node[tier, fit={(youth_x3)(youth_x4)(1,-0.5)(1,1.5)}] (tier-2) {};
#> \node[tier, fit={(oldage_x5)(oldage_x6)(2,-0.5)(2,1.5)}] (tier-3) {};
#> \end{scope}
#> \draw[time axis] ([xshift=-3mm]tier-1.south west) -- ([xshift=5mm]tier-3.south east);
#> \node[tier label, below=3pt] at (tier-1.south) {Childhood};
#> \node[tier label, below=3pt] at (tier-2.south) {youth};
#> \node[tier label, below=3pt] at (tier-3.south) {Old age};
#> \end{tikzpicture}

# Edges are bent around nodes in the way: here A --> C bends around B
cg_line <- caugi::caugi(A %-->% B + C, B %-->% C)
layout_line <- data.frame(name = c("A", "B", "C"), x = c(0, 1, 2), y = 0)
tikz_routed <- make_tikz(
  cg_line,
  layout = layout_line,
  style = "classic",
  full_doc = FALSE
)
cat(tikz_routed)
#> %%% Generated by causalDisco (version 1.3.0)
#> \tikzset{
#>   >={Stealth[length=2.2mm, width=1.7mm]},
#>   o/.tip={Circle[open, length=1.6mm]},
#>   var/.style={inner sep=2pt},
#>   link/.style={semithick},
#>   tier/.style={fill=black!8, inner sep=4pt},
#>   tier label/.style={font=\small},
#>   time axis/.style={semithick, -{Stealth[length=2mm]}}
#> }
#> \begin{tikzpicture}
#> \node[var] (A) at (0,0) {A};
#> \node[var] (B) at (10,0) {B};
#> \node[var] (C) at (20,0) {C};
#> \path[link] (A) edge[->, bend right=10] (B)
#>       (A) edge[->, bend left=20] (C)
#>       (B) edge[->, bend right=10] (C);
#> \end{tikzpicture}

# Draw every edge exactly with the requested bend instead
tikz_exact <- make_tikz(
  cg_line,
  layout = layout_line,
  style = "classic",
  edge_style = list(route = FALSE),
  full_doc = FALSE
)
cat(tikz_exact)
#> %%% Generated by causalDisco (version 1.3.0)
#> \tikzset{
#>   >={Stealth[length=2.2mm, width=1.7mm]},
#>   o/.tip={Circle[open, length=1.6mm]},
#>   var/.style={inner sep=2pt},
#>   link/.style={semithick},
#>   tier/.style={fill=black!8, inner sep=4pt},
#>   tier label/.style={font=\small},
#>   time axis/.style={semithick, -{Stealth[length=2mm]}}
#> }
#> \begin{tikzpicture}
#> \node[var] (A) at (0,0) {A};
#> \node[var] (B) at (10,0) {B};
#> \node[var] (C) at (20,0) {C};
#> \path[link] (A) edge[->, bend right=10] (B)
#>       (A) edge[->, bend right=10] (C)
#>       (B) edge[->, bend right=10] (C);
#> \end{tikzpicture}

# Set the bend of single edges (positive = bend left, negative = bend right);
# these are always drawn exactly as given
tikz_bends <- make_tikz(
  cg_line,
  layout = layout_line,
  style = "classic",
  bend = list(A = list(B = 30, C = 0)),
  full_doc = FALSE
)
cat(tikz_bends)
#> %%% Generated by causalDisco (version 1.3.0)
#> \tikzset{
#>   >={Stealth[length=2.2mm, width=1.7mm]},
#>   o/.tip={Circle[open, length=1.6mm]},
#>   var/.style={inner sep=2pt},
#>   link/.style={semithick},
#>   tier/.style={fill=black!8, inner sep=4pt},
#>   tier label/.style={font=\small},
#>   time axis/.style={semithick, -{Stealth[length=2mm]}}
#> }
#> \begin{tikzpicture}
#> \node[var] (A) at (0,0) {A};
#> \node[var] (B) at (10,0) {B};
#> \node[var] (C) at (20,0) {C};
#> \path[link] (A) edge[->, bend left=30] (B)
#>       (A) edge[->] (C)
#>       (B) edge[->, bend right=30] (C);
#> \end{tikzpicture}


################# Convert Disco to Tikz ################

data(num_data)
kn <- knowledge(
  num_data,
  X1 %-->% X2,
  X2 %!-->% X3 + Y,
  Y %!-->% Z
)

pc_bnlearn <- pc(engine = "bnlearn", test = "fisher_z", alpha = 0.05)
disco_kn <- disco(data = num_data, method = pc_bnlearn, knowledge = kn)

tikz_snippet <- make_tikz(disco_kn, scale = 10, full_doc = FALSE)
cat(tikz_snippet)
#> %%% Generated by causalDisco (version 1.3.0)
#> \tikzset{
#>   var/.style={draw, circle, fill=lightgray},
#>   link/.style={draw=blue, arrows={[scale=3]}}
#> }
#> \begin{tikzpicture}
#> \node[var] (X1) at (7.401,3.504) {X1};
#> \node[var] (X2) at (2.595,3.504) {X2};
#> \node[var] (X3) at (0,0) {X3};
#> \node[var] (Z) at (10,0.001) {Z};
#> \node[var] (Y) at (4.999,0.188) {Y};
#> \path (X1) edge[link, -Latex] (X2)
#>       (X1) edge[link, -Latex] (Y)
#>       (X1) edge[link, -] (Z)
#>       (X3) edge[link, -Latex] (X2)
#>       (X3) edge[link, -Latex] (Y)
#>       (Y) edge[link, -Latex] (X2)
#>       (Z) edge[link, -Latex] (Y);
#> \end{tikzpicture}

################# Convert caugi objects to Tikz ################

cg <- caugi::caugi(A %-->% B + C)

tikz_snippet <- make_tikz(
  cg,
  node_style = list(fill = "red"),
  scale = 10,
  full_doc = FALSE
)
cat(tikz_snippet)
#> %%% Generated by causalDisco (version 1.3.0)
#> \tikzset{
#>   var/.style={draw, circle, fill=red},
#>   link/.style={arrows={[scale=3]}}
#> }
#> \begin{tikzpicture}
#> \node[var] (A) at (5,0) {A};
#> \node[var] (B) at (10,10) {B};
#> \node[var] (C) at (0,10) {C};
#> \path (A) edge[link, -Latex] (B)
#>       (A) edge[link, -Latex] (C);
#> \end{tikzpicture}
